narrative.intro: Mistral has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Mistral has 9 awards and an average award size of $23.7M. Mistral's obligations were up 384.3% year over year. Mistral's FY2026 total follows prior-year activity: FY25 obligations were $44M, FY24 obligations were $727K, FY22 obligations were $39.4K, and FY21 obligations were $224K. Mistral's FY2026 work is concentrated in a few markets and buyers. The Department of Defense provided $213M in obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice provided $7.4K. Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing accounted for $191M of obligations, and Aircraft Manufacturing accounted for $22.5M. Mistral recorded $15.1K in Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment (except Automotive and Electronic) Repair and Maintenance and $7.4K in Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing. Current-year totals are partial and cover fiscal year to date. Award-value figures in largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables are total contract values where shown.

sections.heading: How big is Mistral's federal business in FY2026 to date?
sections.body: Mistral has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Mistral has 9 awards with an average award size of $23.7M. Mistral's obligations were up 384.3% year over year. Mistral's FY2026 total is larger than FY25's $44M and FY24's $727K.

sections.heading: Who and what are the primary buyers and markets for Mistral?
sections.body: The Department of Defense bought $213M of Mistral's work in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice bought $7.4K. Other Guided Missile and Space Vehicle Parts and Auxiliary Equipment Manufacturing accounted for $191M and Aircraft Manufacturing accounted for $22.5M.

faq.q: How much does Mistral make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Mistral has $213M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Mistral has 9 awards and an average award size of $23.7M. Mistral's obligations were up 384.3% year over year. The FY2026 total follows FY25's $44M, FY24's $727K, FY22's $39.4K, and FY21's $224K.

The Department of Defense buys the most from Mistral, providing $213M in obligations in FY2026 to date. The Department of Justice provided $7.4K. No other agencies are listed among the top buyers for FY2026 to date.

faq.q: What does Mistral sell to the government?
faq.a: Mistral sells guided-missile and space vehicle parts and auxiliary equipment, with $191M in obligations in that NAICS. Mistral also sells aircraft manufacturing products, with $22.5M in obligations, plus smaller amounts in Commercial and Industrial Machinery and Equipment Repair and Maintenance ($15.1K) and Irradiation Apparatus Manufacturing ($7.4K).

faq.q: Which Mistral contracts are expiring soon?
